outcome: adverse neonatal outcome (Neonatal Intensive Care Unit hospitalization, mechanical ventilation, continuous positive airway pressure, sepsis, necrotizing enterocolitis, intraventricular hemorrhage grade III or IV, neonatal death before discharge)
cohort: The study included 102 women with singleton gestation and small-for-gestational age (SGA) newborns delivered at or after 34 weeks of gestation.
finding: Measurements of maternal serum sFlt-1 or PlGF provide poor prediction of adverse neonatal outcomes in pregnancies with SGA, while birth weight was identified as an independent risk factor.
